biography: Michel Dubois, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and exasperation in the French racing scene, hails from the small town of Thiers, nestled in the Auvergne region. His journey began not on asphalt, but on the winding dirt roads of his family's farm, tearing around on an old Peugeot 103 moped. He transitioned to karting at 16, showing promise but also a frustrating tendency to either win spectacularly or crash out spectacularly. Dubois's big break came unexpectedly; a wealthy patron, impressed by his raw speed (and perhaps entertained by his volatile nature), funded his entry into Porsche racing. His early years were a rollercoaster; flashes of brilliance in his Porsche 911 RSR 74 were often overshadowed by costly mistakes. Now, nearing 40, Dubois is a veteran presence, still capable of stunning performances, but battling consistency.
drivingStyle: Dubois is an all-or-nothing driver, a true 'send it' merchant. He attacks corners with ferocious commitment, often pushing the limit of adhesion. His tire management is, charitably speaking, 'aggressive', favoring a blistering early pace over a long, consistent stint. Under pressure, Dubois tends to either crack or rise to the occasion, making him an unpredictable opponent in wheel-to-wheel combat. It's a style that's thrilling to watch, but rarely conducive to championship success.

rivalries.name: Jean-Pierre 'Le Professeur' Moreau
rivalries.reason: A clash of styles; Moreau's calculated precision directly opposes Dubois's impulsive aggression, leading to numerous on-track incidents and heated exchanges.

rivalries.name: Isabelle 'The Ice Queen' Laurent
rivalries.reason: A constant battle for supremacy within the French racing scene; Laurent consistently outperforms Dubois, fueling his frustration and competitiveness.

rivalries.name: Enzo 'Il Bello' Bellini
rivalries.reason: A rivalry born from a shared love of flamboyant racing and a mutual disdain for backing down, often resulting in spectacular crashes.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of the weather.
Refuses to speak to anyone for an hour before a race, claiming it helps him 'focus his energy'.
Has a bizarre obsession with collecting miniature Eiffel Tower replicas.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I race to win, or I crash trying."
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours in a massive upset in 2012, after his co-driver crashed in qualifying forcing him to start at the back of the grid, fighting his way through the field with a series of daring overtakes.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2015, handing the victory to his arch-rival Jean-Pierre Moreau.
